response_text: SAY: "Honestly, I’m a big fan of anything design‑related—whether it’s sketching up a new logo, rearranging a room for better flow, or just playing around with color palettes on my computer. I’ve been trying to land a design job lately, so I’m spending a lot of time polishing my portfolio. When I’m not doing that, I love taking short drives to see new neighborhoods (though the night traffic noise can be a bit overwhelming for me). I also miss my old dog Bruno; I used to take him on walks and we’d stop at little cafés where I’d sketch the people around us. Right now I’m pretty hungry and a bit tired from the drive, but I could talk about design all night!"
